note: indicator contains "percent" => value is basis points: divide by 100 for display (500 => 5%). Otherwise flat integer.

accuracy.label: Accuracy Bonus
accuracy.description:
Prevents attack from missing.
Affected by target's Evasion.

additionalhitrate.label: Multi-hit Chance
additionalhitrate.description: Increases Multi-hit Chance. Adds up to 4 hits, inflicting damage proportional to Attack.

amplifyalldamage.label: Damage Boost
amplifyalldamage.description: Boosts Damage. Affected by target's Damage Tolerance.

amplifybackattack.label: Back Attack Damage Boost
amplifybackattack.description: Boost Damage when successfully attacking from behind. Ignores target's Block when attacking from behind.

amplifycriticaldamage.label: Critical Damage Boost
amplifycriticaldamage.description: Boosts Critical Hit Damage. Affected by target's Critical Damage Tolerance.

amplifyfrontattack.label: Frontal Attack Damage Boost
amplifyfrontattack.description: Boosts Damage when successfully attacking from the front.

amplifyweapondamage.label: Weapon Damage Boost
amplifyweapondamage.description: Boosts Weapon Damage. Affected by target's Weapon Damage Tolerance.

backattackcritical.label: Back Attack Critical Hit
backattackcritical.description: Increases Critical Hit Rate when attacking from behind. Ignores target's Block when attacking from behind.

backattackcriticalresist.label: Back Attack Critical Hit Resist
backattackcriticalresist.description: Reduces target's Critical Hit Rate when attacked from behind.

backattackdamage.label: Back Attack
backattackdamage.description: Increases Damage when successfully attacking from behind. Ignores target's Block when attacking from behind.

backattackdefense.label: Back Defense
backattackdefense.description: Reduces Damage taken when attacked from behind.

battlehpregen.label: Combat Natural HP Regen
battlehpregen.description: Restores HP at set intervals during combat.

battlempregen.label: Combat Natural MP Regen
battlempregen.description: Restores MP at set intervals during combat.

battlespregen.label: Combat Natural Stamina Regen
battlespregen.description: Restores Stamina at set intervals during combat.

block.label: Block
block.description: Increases Parry Chance and Shield Block Chance. Can Parry after blocking with shield. Affected by target's Accuracy and Block Penetration. ※ Block Damage Reduction Rate varies based on Gear Grade.

bossnpcamplifydamage.label: Boss Damage Boost
bossnpcamplifydamage.description: Boosts Damage on Boss. Affected by target's Boss Damage Tolerance.

combatspeed.label: Combat Speed
combatspeed.description: Increases Attack Speed and Spell Action Speed.

critical.label: Critical Hit
critical.description: Increases Critical Hit Rate. Max Critical Hit Rate is 80%, and this is reduced by target's Critical Hit Resist.

criticaladddamage.label: Critical Attack
criticaladddamage.description:
Increases Damage when a Critical Hit occurs.
Affected by target's Critical Damage Defense.

criticaldamagedefense.label: Critical Damage Defense
criticaldamagedefense.description: Reduces Damage taken from Critical Hit.

criticalresist.label: Critical Hit Resist
criticalresist.description: Reduces chance of receiving Critical Hits.

decreasebackattack.label: Back Attack Damage Tolerance
decreasebackattack.description: Weakens Damage taken when attacked from behind.

decreasecriticaldamage.label: Critical Damage Tolerance
decreasecriticaldamage.description: Weakens Critical Hit Damage taken from Critical Hit.

decreasefrontattack.label: Frontal Attack Damage Tolerance
decreasefrontattack.description: Weakens Damage taken when attacked from the front.

defensepierce.label: Penetration
defensepierce.description: Ignores target's Defense. Defense does not fall below 0.

evasion.label: Evasion Bonus
evasion.description: Evading attacks prevents damage. Max Evasion rate is 50%.

frontattackcritical.label: Frontal Attack Critical Hit
frontattackcritical.description: Increases Critical Hit Rate when attacking from the front.

frontattackcriticalresist.label: Frontal Critical Hit Resist
frontattackcriticalresist.description: Reduces target's Critical Hit Rate when attacked from the front.

frontattackdamage.label: Frontal Attack
frontattackdamage.description: Increases Damage when successfully attacking from the front.

frontattackdefense.label: Frontal Defense
frontattackdefense.description: Reduces Damage taken when attacked from the front.

hardhit.label: Smite
hardhit.description: Increases Smite activation chance. Affected by target's Smite Resist. ※ Smite: Deals greatly increased Damage based on Final Damage.

hardhitresist.label: Smite Resist
hardhitresist.description: Reduces target's Smite activation chance when attacked.

hpmax.label: HP
hpmax.description: Character HP. Character dies when HP drops to 0.

hppotionregen.label: HP Potion Recovery
hppotionregen.description: Increases amount recovered when using HP Potion.

ironwall.label: Endurance
ironwall.description: Increases Endurance activation chance. Affected by target's Endurance Penetration. ※ Endurance: Reduces Damage by half.

movespeed.label: Move Speed
movespeed.description:
Increases Walk Speed or Run Speed.
Move Speed cannot exceed 150%.

mpmax.label: MP
mpmax.description: Certain skills require MP for casting them.

mpusedecrease.label: MP Cost Reduction
mpusedecrease.description: Reduces the amount of MP consumed.

perfect.label: Perfect Chance
perfect.description: Increases Perfect activation chance. Affected by target's Perfect Resist. ※ Perfect: Deals increased Damage based on weapon's Max Attack.

perfectresist.label: Perfect Resist
perfectresist.description: Reduces target's Perfect activation chance when attacked.

pveaccuracy.label: PvE Accuracy
pveaccuracy.description:
Accuracy added when attacking monsters.
Offset by monsters' Evasion and Block.

pveamplifydamage.label: PvE Damage Boost
pveamplifydamage.description: Boosts Damage on Monster. Affected by target's PvE Damage Tolerance.

pvedamagedefense.label: PvE Defense
pvedamagedefense.description: Reduces Damage taken when attacked by Monster.

pvedecreasedamage.label: PvE Damage Tolerance
pvedecreasedamage.description: Weakens Damage taken when attacked by Monster.

pvpaccuracy.label: PvP Accuracy
pvpaccuracy.description:
Accuracy added when attacking characters.
Offset by the character's Evasion and Block.

pvpamplifydamage.label: PvP Damage Boost
pvpamplifydamage.description: Boosts damage when attacking characters. Affected by the target's PvP Damage Tolerance.

pvpcritical.label: PvP Critical Hit
pvpcritical.description: Increases Critical Hit Rate when attacking Character.

pvpcriticalresist.label: PvP Critical Hit Resist
pvpcriticalresist.description: Reduces target's Critical Hit Rate when attacked by Character.

pvpdamagedefense.label: PvP Defense
pvpdamagedefense.description: Reduces Damage taken when attacked by Character.

pvpdecreasedamage.label: PvP Damage Tolerance
pvpdecreasedamage.description: Weakens Damage taken when attacked by Character.

pvpevasion.label: PvP Evasion
pvpevasion.description: Evades Character's Attack. Max Evasion Rate is 50%.

resthpregen.label: Out-of-Combat Natural HP Regen
resthpregen.description: Restores HP at set intervals when out of combat.

restmpregen.label: Out-of-Combat Natural MP Regen
restmpregen.description: Restores MP at set intervals when out of combat.

restoration.label: Regeneration
restoration.description: Increases Regeneration activation chance. Affected by target's Regeneration Penetration. ※ Regeneration: Recovers a portion of Damage as HP.

restspregen.label: Out-of-Combat Natural Stamina Regen
restspregen.description: Restores Stamina at set intervals when out of combat.

spmax.label: Stamina
spmax.description:
Consumed when sprinting or evading.
Applies when sprinting normally or while riding a pet.

weapondamage.label: Max Attack
weapondamage.description: Max Attack of the weapon. Perfect scales with Max Attack.
